findings.detail: The pct_of_net_assets identity check is firing on exact residuals even though the source % of Net Assets column is rounded to two decimals.

rationale: Raw source shows Total net assets of 593,835,119. Representative flagged rows reconcile when the displayed % of Net Assets is treated as a two-decimal rounded disclosure: Smarsh Revolver fair value 89,033 equals 0.01499% of net assets, displayed as 0.01%; GI Apple DDTL fair value 206,691 equals 0.03480%, displayed as 0.03%; Allentown Revolver fair value 84,405 equals 0.01421%, displayed as 0.01%; Amber Energy fair value 45,874 equals 0.00772%, displayed as 0.01%. The residuals are caused by an over-tight exact identity check, not by wrong source data.
